identity: Thunderroot Wilds is the trolls' storm jungle at the Throng's far flank; bog witches bottle its thunder and bandits sell what the storm leaves.

quests.title: [PH] Ashveil Listens Too
quests.text: [PH] Rumela sends the player to Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise; no earlier deed is claimed. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: [PH] The Next Crew Should Know
quests.text: [PH] Rumela wants a prepared reading cord with the carriers' reports secured on the loading ground of the guild camp, for the next crew; no forecast, no riddle. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A local task of the zone's own people.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The camp's held load (a town place every mining camp has).

quests.title: [PH] One Stolen Storm Fewer
quests.text: [PH] Rumela wants a stored storm vessel made useless at the {name:storm_store} in the {name:stormglades}; no weather changes, no fight starts. Real text to follow.
quests.completion: [PH] A visible success of the zone's own before any party goes after Storm-Bottle. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K9 A: the zone's solo quest with its weapon, at a new recipe place in the Stormglades; the new object kind storm_vessel (a placeholder look until the user's art pick).

quests.title: [PH] Party: Storm-Bottle
quests.text: [PH] Rumela asks for a party against {name:storm_bottle_witch} in the {name:heartwood}, whose other stores and own violence remain; optional, nothing needs it. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.

quests.title: [PH] Standards at Tornstandard
quests.text: [PH] Rumela sends the player to Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold; neither the vessel nor Storm-Bottle is assumed. Real text to follow.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The departure at 40 (round61-plan.md §2 point 7); free, it requires nothing.
